title: UACR: Uncertainty-Aware Collaborative Routing for Explainable Industrial Anomaly Inspection
abstract: arXiv:2611.28655v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection requires not only accurate anomaly discrimination but also trustworthy explanations for operators, while satisfying the strict latency constraints of online inspection. Existing methods, however, typically apply a fixed computational path to all samples, making it difficult to strike a good balance among detection accuracy, inference efficiency, and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose UACR, an uncertainty-aware collaborative routing framework for explainable industrial anomaly inspection. UACR aims to deliver reliable anomaly decisions together with operator-facing explanations under the online inspection budget, while adaptively allocating computation so that ambiguous cases receive deeper scrutiny. translated_title: UACR：面向可解释工业异常检测的不确定性感知协同路由
translated_abstract: 工业异常检测不仅需要对异常进行准确判别，还需要为操作人员提供可信的解释，同时满足在线检测严格的延迟约束。然而，现有方法通常对所有样本采用固定的计算路径，难以在检测精度、推理效率和可解释性之间取得良好的平衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了UACR，一种面向可解释工业异常检测的不确定性感知协同路由框架。UACR旨在在线检测预算内提供可靠的异常决策以及面向操作人员的解释，同时自适应地分配计算资源，使模糊不确定的样本接受更深入的检查。该框架由两个阶段组成：阶段I为离线训练与路由超参数搜索，学习异常检测模块并校准驱动路由的不确定性估计器（原文摘要至此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了不确定性感知协同路由框架UACR，通过基于样本不确定性自适应分配计算资源，在在线检测延迟约束下同时实现准确的异常判别、面向操作人员的可信解释与高效的推理。
